blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines—Filipino-American social media personality Bretman Rock once again proved that Halloween is one of his favorite celebrations, sharing another creative costume transformation with his niece Cleo for 2026. In a series of photos posted on Instagram, Bretman channeled Rapunzel from Disney’s animated film “Tangled”, complete with the character’s signature long blonde hair, while Cleo dressed up as Pascal, Rapunzel’s beloved chameleon companion. The Halloween celebration was made even more special as Cleo also marked her 10th birthday on October 31 in Hawaii, USA.
